074/**
075 * This class manages a hierarchy of named TextStyles; a TextStyle is an
076 * {@link AttributeSet} with a limited list of attribute names, see below.
077 * There are methods to apply an {@code AttributeSet} to either a
078 * {@code JTextCompoent} or {@code JTextArea}.
079 * <p>
080 * The styles are usually
081 * read from a resource/file.
082 * After styles are loaded, then {@link #executeFullStyleDiagnostics(boolean)}
083 * is run and results logged. If there's an exception/error during loading
084 * and/or diagnostics fail then the load is backed out.
085 * See {@link LoadStatus}.
086 * <p>
087 * Other than the methods that operate on {@code JTextComponents}
088 * only {@link #getStyleNames()} and {@link #getStyle(java.lang.String)}
089 * can be called from the {@link EventQueue}. If a method is called from an
090 * inappropriate thread an {@code IllegalStateException} is thrown.
091 *
092 * <style>
093 *   th, td {
094 *     padding-left: 15px;
095 *     padding-right: 15px;
096 *     padding-top: 1px;
097 *     padding-bottom: 1px;
098 *   }
099 * </style>
100 *
101 * <table border="1">
102 * <caption>Attributes in a TextStyle</caption>
103 * <thead>
104 * <tr>
105 * <th> Attribute Name </th><th> Acceptable Values </th><th>Default</th>
106 * <th> Target Component</th>
107 * </tr>
108 * </thead>
109 *
110 * <tbody>
111 * <tr>
112 * <td> foreground </td><td> Color: #ff2277, name </td><td>BLACK</td>
113 * <td> JComponent </td>
114 * </tr><tr>
115 * <td> background </td><td> Color: #ff2277, name </td><td>WHITE</td>
116 * <td> JComponent </td>
117 * </tr><tr>
118 * <td> opaque </td><td> true,false </td><td>true</td>
119 * <td> JComponent </td>
120 * </tr><tr>
121 * <td> fontFamily </td><td> String </td><td>"Monospaced"</td>
122 * <td> JComponent </td>
123 * </tr><tr>
124 * <td> fontSize </td><td> int </td><td>12</td>
125 * <td> JComponent </td>
126 * </tr><tr>
127 * <td> bold </td><td> true, false </td><td>false</td>
128 * <td> JComponent </td>
129 * </tr><tr>
130 * <td> italic </td><td> true, false </td><td>false</td>
131 * <td> JComponent </td>
132 * </tr><tr>
133 * <td> underline </td><td> true, false </td><td>false</td>
134 * <td> JComponent </td>
135 * </tr><tr>
136 * <td> strikethrough </td><td> true, false </td><td>false</td>
137 * <td> JComponent </td>
138 * </tr><tr>
139 * <td> alignment </td><td> "left", "center", "right" </td><td>"left"</td>
140 * <td> JTextField </td>
141 * </tr><tr>
142 * <td> linewrap </td><td> true, false </td><td>false</td>
143 * <td> JTextArea </td>
144 * </tr><tr>
145 * <td> wordwrap </td><td> true, false </td><td>false</td>
146 * <td> JTextArea </td>
147 * </tr><tr>
148 * <td> scrollbars </td>
149 * <td> "both", "vertical", "horizontal",<br>"asneeded", "none" </td><td>"asneeded"</td>
150 * <td> JTextArea </td>
151 * </tr><tr>
152 * <td> autoscroll </td><td> true, false </td><td>ignore</td>
153 * <td> JTextArea </td>
154 * </tr>
155 * </tbody>
156 * </table>
157 * <p>
158 * <ul>
159 * <li>
160 * There are two special words, <b>"keep"</b> and <b>"default"</b>, which are acceptable
161 * values for any style attribute. "keep" means that the current component
162 * value be unaltered when the style is applied. "default" means use the default value.
163 * <li>
164 * If an attribute is not specified, then "keep" is assumed.
165 * <li>
166 * If a color starts with "#" try {@link Color#decode(String)}; if not try
167 * matching the value to a name of a color as seen in {@link Color}'s fields.
168 * <li>
169 * If a style is applied to a component, and the style has attributes that are
170 * not applicable to the component, the inapplicable attributes are ignored.
171 * <li>
172 * The scroll related styles are only applied if the JTextArea is embedded in a ScrollPane
173 * </ul>
174 *
175 * There are two supported
176 * formats for specifying styles, json and properties.
177 *
178 * <pre>
179 * # comments allowed in json             |
180 * {                                      |
181 *   "default": {                         |
182 *     "foreground": "#333333",           |      default.foreground=#333333
183 *     "background": "#FFFFFF",           |      default.background=#FFFFFF
184 *     "fontFamily": "Monospaced",        |      default.fontFamily=Monospaced
185 *     "fontSize": 16,                    |      default.fontSize=16
186 *     "alignment": "left"                |      default.alignment=left
187 *   },                                   |
188 *   "warning": {                         |
189 *     "inherits": "default",             |      warning.inherits=default
190 *     "background": "#FFF3CD",           |      warning.background=#FFF3CD
191 *     "alignment": "center"              |      warning.alignment=center
192 *   },                                   |
193 *   "criticalError": {                   |
194 *     "inherits": "warning",             |      criticalError.inherits=warning
195 *     "alignment": "right",              |      criticalError.alignment=right
196 *     "foreground": "#721C24",           |      criticalError.foreground=#721C24
197 *     "strikethrough": true,             |      criticalError.strikethrough=true
198 *     "underline": "default"             |      criticalError.underline=default
199 *   }                                    |
200 * }                                      |
201 * </pre>
202 * Each produces, as displayed by {@link #generateDiagnosticTrees(StringBuilder) }:
203 * <pre>
204 * Resolved Structural Hierarchy Trees:
205 * └── default
206 *       • foreground = java.awt.Color[r=51,g=51,b=51]
207 *       • background = java.awt.Color[r=255,g=255,b=255]
208 *       • family = Monospaced
209 *       • size = 16
210 *       • alignment = left
211 *     └── warning
212 *           • background = java.awt.Color[r=255,g=243,b=205]
213 *           • alignment = center
214 *         └── criticalError
215 *               • alignment = right
216 *               • foreground = java.awt.Color[r=114,g=28,b=36]
217 *               • strikethrough = true
218 *               • underline = default
219 * </pre>
220 */
221public class TextStyles {
222  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();

292  /**
293   * Get a Set of all the StyleNames.
294   * @return
295   */
296  public static Set<String> getStyleNames() {
297    Set<String> currentStyleNames = new HashSet<>(registry.keySet());
298    currentStyleNames.removeAll(newStyleNames);
299    return currentStyleNames;
300  }
301
302  /**
303   * Return the Style, ie AttributeSet, for the name,
304   * that is guaranteed not to change over time.
305   * @param styleName
306   * @return AttributeSet or null if doesn't exist
307   */
308  public static AttributeSet getStyle(String styleName) {
309    if (styleName == null || newStyleNames.contains(styleName))
310      return null;
311    AttributeSet style = readOnlyRegistry.get(styleName);
312    if (style != null)
313      return style;
314    AttributeSet resolvedStyle = getResolvedStyle(styleName);
315    if (resolvedStyle == null)
316      return null;
317    SimpleAttributeSet newAttrs = new SimpleAttributeSet();
318    flatten(getResolvedStyle(styleName), newAttrs);
319    newAttrs.removeAttribute(StyleConstants.ResolveAttribute);
320    AttributeSet roAttrs = new AttributeSetDelegate(newAttrs);
321    readOnlyRegistry.put(styleName, roAttrs);
322    return roAttrs;
323  }
324
325  private static void flatten(AttributeSet origAttrs, MutableAttributeSet newAttrs) {
326    if (origAttrs == null)
327      return;
328    flatten(origAttrs.getResolveParent(), newAttrs);
329    newAttrs.addAttributes(origAttrs);
330  }

344  static void verifyNotEDT() {
345    if (EventQueue.isDispatchThread())
346      throw new IllegalStateException("Synchronized method called from EDT.");
347  }
348
349  static void verifyEDT() {
350    if (!EventQueue.isDispatchThread())
351      throw new IllegalStateException("Swing method not called from EDT.");
352  }

354  /**
355   * Executes the validation scanner and structural hierarchy printer independently,
356   * gathers their generated text outputs and log them INFO.
357   * If toConsole, then also prints them to the console.
358   *
359   * @param toConsole
360   * @return true if everythings OK.
361   */
362  @SuppressWarnings("UseOfSystemOutOrSystemErr")
363  public static synchronized LoadStatus executeFullStyleDiagnostics(boolean toConsole) {
364    verifyNotEDT();
365    // 1. Run validation engine and gather report string
366    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(600);
367    boolean healthy = runDiagnostics(sb);
368    String diagnostics = sb.toString();
369    logger.log(INFO, () -> sf("\n%s", diagnostics));
370    if (toConsole)
371      System.out.print(sb.toString());
372    if (!healthy)
373      logger.log(ERROR, () -> sf("Style diagnotics failed."));
374
375    // 2. Locate root nodes and generate structural tree map string
376    sb.setLength(0);
377    generateDiagnosticTrees(sb);
378    String trees = sb.toString();
379    sb.append("=======================================================\n");
380
381    logger.log(INFO, () -> sf("\n%s", sb.toString()));
382    if (toConsole)
383      System.out.print(sb.toString());
384    return new LoadStatus(healthy, diagnostics, trees);
385  }
386
387  /**
388   * This structural hierarchy printer builds the text block string.
389   * @param sb
390   */
391  public static synchronized void generateDiagnosticTrees(StringBuilder sb) {
392    verifyNotEDT();
393    sb.append("Resolved Structural Hierarchy Trees:\n");
394
395    Set<String> roots = new HashSet<>(registry.keySet());
396    roots.removeAll(inheritanceMap.keySet());
397
398    for (String root : roots) {
399      generateDiagnosticTree(sb, root, "", true);
400    }
401  }
402
403  /**
404   * This validation scanner analyzes configurations, runs a full property count
405   * metric calculation, and compiles the final verification text block string.
406   * @param sb accumulate the output in here.
407   * @return true if no problems
408   */
409  public static synchronized boolean runDiagnostics(StringBuilder sb) {
410    verifyNotEDT();
411    sb.append("\n=======================================================\n");
412    sb.append("        THEME VALIDATION & DIAGNOSTIC REPORT\n");
413    sb.append("=======================================================\n");
414
415    boolean systemHealthy = true;
416    int brokenInheritancePointers = 0;
417    int circularLoopFailures = 0;
418
419    // Perform integrity validations
420    for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : inheritanceMap.entrySet()) {
421      String child = entry.getKey();
422      String parent = entry.getValue();
423
424      if (!registry.containsKey(parent)) {
425        sb.append("[VALIDATION ERROR] Configuration '")
426            .append(child)
427            .append("' inherits from missing parent '")
428            .append(parent)
429            .append("'\n");
430        systemHealthy = false;
431        brokenInheritancePointers++;
432      }
433
434      try {
435        checkCircularReference(child, new HashSet<>());
436      } catch (TextStylesException e) {
437        sb.append("[VALIDATION ERROR] ").append(e.getMessage()).append("\n");
438        systemHealthy = false;
439        circularLoopFailures++;
440      }
441    }
442
443    if (systemHealthy) {
444      sb.append("[STATUS] Validation successful! No broken pointers or cyclic rules found.\n\n");
445    } else {
446      sb.append("[STATUS] Validation failed. See errors logged above.\n\n");
447    }
448
449    // --- NEW METRICS SUMMARY CALCULATION SECTION ---
450    int totalProfilesLoaded = registry.size();
451    int customInheritedProfiles = inheritanceMap.size();
452    int standaloneRootProfiles = totalProfilesLoaded - customInheritedProfiles;
453
454    int totalIndividualAttributesParsed = 0;
455    for (SimpleAttributeSet attrSet : registry.values()) {
456      if (attrSet != null) {
457        totalIndividualAttributesParsed += attrSet.getAttributeCount();
458        if (attrSet.isDefined(StyleConstants.NameAttribute))
459          totalIndividualAttributesParsed -= 1;
460      }
461    }
462
463    sb.append("SUMMARY COUNT METRICS:\n");
464    sb.append("  • Total Profiles Loaded       = ").append(totalProfilesLoaded).append("\n");
465    sb.append("  • Standalone Root Profiles    = ").append(standaloneRootProfiles).append("\n");
466    sb.append("  • Inherited Child Profiles    = ").append(customInheritedProfiles).append("\n");
467    sb.append("  • Total Attributes Configured = ")
468        .append(totalIndividualAttributesParsed)
469        .append("\n");
470
471    if (!systemHealthy) {
472      sb.append("  • Broken Parent Links Found   = ")
473          .append(brokenInheritancePointers)
474          .append("\n");
475      sb.append("  • Circular Reference Loops    = ").append(circularLoopFailures).append("\n");
476    }
477    sb.append("\n");
478
479    return systemHealthy;
480  }
481
482  /**
483   * Recursively traverses configuration branches, formats the multi-component
484   * attribute outputs, and returns a single formatted tree structural block string.
485   *
486   * @param sb accumulates the formatted tree
487   * @param styleName
488   * @param prefix indent so display nests
489   * @param isLast
490   */
491  static void generateDiagnosticTree(StringBuilder sb, String styleName, String prefix,
492                                     boolean isLast) {
493    verifyNotEDT();
494    sb.append(prefix).append(isLast ? "└── " : "├── ").append(styleName).append("\n");
495
496    SimpleAttributeSet localAttributes = registry.get(styleName);
497    if (localAttributes != null) {
498      String attrPrefix = prefix + (isLast ? "    " : "│   ");
499
500      // Map over native StyleConstants
501      appendStyleConstantIfPresent(sb, attrPrefix, localAttributes);
502
503      // Map over JTextArea and Scroll configuration parameters explicitly
504      appendCustomAttributeIfPresent(sb, attrPrefix, localAttributes, STYLE_CONSTANT_LINE_WRAP,
505                                     "JTextArea Line Wrap");
506      appendCustomAttributeIfPresent(sb, attrPrefix, localAttributes, STYLE_CONSTANT_WORD_WRAP,
507                                     "JTextArea Word Wrap");
508      appendCustomAttributeIfPresent(sb, attrPrefix, localAttributes, STYLE_CONSTANT_SCROLLBARS,
509                                     "JScrollPane Policy");
510      appendCustomAttributeIfPresent(sb, attrPrefix, localAttributes, STYLE_CONSTANT_AUTOSCROLL,
511                                     "JScrollPane Autoscroll");
512    }
513
514    // Locate downstream dependents
515    List<String> children = new ArrayList<>();
516    for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : inheritanceMap.entrySet()) {
517      if (entry.getValue().equals(styleName)) {
518        children.add(entry.getKey());
519      }
520    }
521
522    for (int i = 0; i < children.size(); i++) {
523      boolean lastChild = (i == children.size() - 1);
524      generateDiagnosticTree(sb, children.get(i), prefix + (isLast ? "    " : "│   "), lastChild);
525    }
526  }
527
528  /**
529   * Inspects standard StyleConstants parameters to log out core properties.
530   */
531  private static void appendStyleConstantIfPresent(StringBuilder sb, String prefix,
532                                                   AttributeSet style) {
533    // Query attributes directly from the specific profile block
534    // style.getAttributeNames().asIterator().forEachRemaining(name -> {
535    // });
536    for (Enumeration<?> names = style.getAttributeNames(); names.hasMoreElements();) {
537      Object name = names.nextElement();
538
539      // Filter out custom properties handled by the secondary parser block
540      switch (name.toString()) {
541        case STYLE_CONSTANT_LINE_WRAP, STYLE_CONSTANT_WORD_WRAP,
542            STYLE_CONSTANT_SCROLLBARS, STYLE_CONSTANT_AUTOSCROLL -> {
543          continue;
544        }
545      }
546      if (name == StyleConstants.NameAttribute)
547        continue;
548
549      Object value = style.getAttribute(name);
550      String cleanName = name.toString();
551
552      boolean isSpecial = ATTRIBUTE_KEEP.equals(value) || ATTRIBUTE_DEFAULT.equals(value);
553
554      // Translate the abstract styling keys to human-friendly layout strings
555      // Taken out, better to match style files, See StyleDiagnosticEngine
556
557      // Most known key names are simple lower case words except Alignment.
558      // And translate value to knows strings
559      if (!isSpecial && cleanName.contains("Alignment")) {
560        cleanName = "alignment";
561        int align = StyleConstants.getAlignment(style);
562        value = (align == StyleConstants.ALIGN_CENTER)  ? "center"
563                : (align == StyleConstants.ALIGN_RIGHT) ? "right"
564                                                        : "left";
565      }
566
567      sb.append(prefix).append("  • ").append(cleanName).append(" = ").append(value).append("\n");
568    }
569  }
570
571  /**
572   * Helper mapping method to securely extract custom context keys out of target
573   * AttributeSet objects.
574   */
575  private static void appendCustomAttributeIfPresent(StringBuilder sb, String prefix,
576                                                     AttributeSet style, String key,
577                                                     @SuppressWarnings("unused") String label) {
578    Object val = style.getAttribute(key);
579    if (val == null)
580      return;
581    sb.append(prefix).append("  • ").append(key).append(" = ").append(val).append("\n");
582  }
583
584  private static void checkCircularReference(String current, Set<String> visited) {
585    logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("checkCircularReference: %s: %s", current, visited.toString()));
586    if (visited.contains(current)) {
587      throw new TextStylesException(
588          "Circular inheritance path detected: " + String.join(" -> ", visited) + " -> " + current);
589    }
590    visited.add(current);
591    String parent = inheritanceMap.get(current);
592    if (parent != null) {
593      checkCircularReference(parent, visited);
594    }
595  }

597  private static AttributeSet getResolvedStyle(String targetStyle) {
598    return getResolvedStyleHelper(targetStyle, new HashSet<>());
599  }
600
601  // It seems like, in getResolvedStyleHelper, the line
602  //     if(currentParentStyle != null && !Objects.equals(parentStyle, currentParentStyle))
603  // could be replaced by
604  //     if(currentParentStyle != null && parentStyle != currentParentStyle)
605  //
606  // Is it worth doing something to avoid re-resolving every time?
607  //
608  // TODO: if(!resolved) resolve evertythinge
609  //   OR: resolve as load
610  //   OR: if (!resolved(name)) as load
611  //   OR: resolveChainHierarchy(styleName); short circuits
612  // return getResolvedStyle(styleName);
613  // return registry.get(current);
614  //
615  private static AttributeSet getResolvedStyleHelper(String currentName, Set<String> visited) {
616    logger.log(DEBUG, sf("resolveChainHierarchyHelper: %s: %s", currentName, visited.toString()));
617    if (visited.contains(currentName)) {
618      throw new TextStylesException(
619          "resolveChainHierarchyHelper: Circular inheritance path detected: "
620          + String.join(" -> ", visited) + " -> " + currentName);
621    }
622
623    SimpleAttributeSet currentStyle = registry.get(currentName);
624    if (currentStyle == null)
625      return null;
626
627    visited.add(currentName);
628    String parentName = inheritanceMap.get(currentName);
629
630    if (parentName != null && registry.containsKey(parentName)) {
631      AttributeSet parentStyle = getResolvedStyleHelper(parentName, visited);
632      AttributeSet currentParentStyle = currentStyle.getResolveParent();
633      if (currentParentStyle != null && parentStyle != currentParentStyle) {
634        String s = sf("%s old/new parent: %s != %s", parentName, parentStyle, currentParentStyle);
635        logger.log(ERROR, s);
636        throw new TextStylesException(s);
637      }
638      if (parentStyle != null) {
639        currentStyle.setResolveParent(parentStyle);
640        logger.log(DEBUG, sf("setResolveParent: %s %s", currentName, parentName));
641      }
642    }
643    return currentStyle;
644  }

651  /**
652   * Returned by load*. If error, then no changes made. diagnostics and trees
653   * are the results of running executeFullStyleDiagnostics after the load
654   * finishes.
655   */
656  public record LoadStatus(boolean ok, String diagnostics, String trees) {}
657
658  private static String currentLoadFileName;
659
660  /**
661   * Load styles from a file.
662   * If an exception occurs while processing, any changes
663   * made up to the exception are backed out.
664   *
665   * @param path must have either {@code .properties} or {@code .json} extension
666   * @return
667   * @throws IOException
668   */
669  public static synchronized LoadStatus loadStyles(Path path) throws IOException {
670    verifyNotEDT();
671    String lowerPath = path.toString().toLowerCase();
672    if (lowerPath.endsWith(".json")) {
673      return loadStylesFromJson(path);
674    } else if (lowerPath.endsWith(".properties")) {
675      return loadStylesFromProperties(path);
676    } else {
677      throw new IllegalArgumentException(sf("Unsupported file extension on '%s'", path.toString()));
678    }
679  }
680
681  // Set up initial state before load, so can back out any changes if errors.
682  private static void loadStylesStarting() {
683    initialStyleNames.clear();
684    newStyleNames.clear();
685    initialStyleNames.addAll(registry.keySet());
686  }
687
688  // If not a cleanFinish or diagnostics fail, then back out any changes made by load.
689  private static LoadStatus loadStylesCompleted(boolean cleanFinish) {
690    LoadStatus status = executeFullStyleDiagnostics(false);
691    if (!(cleanFinish && status.ok)) {
692      newStyleNames.stream().forEach(item -> {
693        registry.remove(item);
694        inheritanceMap.remove(item);
695      });
696      // make sure ok is false
697      status = new LoadStatus(false, status.diagnostics, status.trees);
698    }
699    initialStyleNames.clear();
700    newStyleNames.clear();
701    return status;
702  }
703
704  private interface BiFunctionIO<T, U, R> {
705    R apply(T t, U u) throws IOException;
706  }
707
708  /**
709   * All load methods go through here
710   * @param parseToMap parses either json or properties.
711   */
712  private static LoadStatus loadStyles(
713      Reader reader, String fName,
714      BiFunctionIO<Reader, String, Map<String, Map<String, String>>> parseToMap)
715      throws IOException {
716    verifyNotEDT();
717    boolean cleanFinish = false;
718    LoadStatus status;
719    loadStylesStarting();
720    currentLoadFileName = fName;
721    try {
722      Map<String, Map<String, String>> styles = parseToMap.apply(reader, fName);
723      loadStylesFromMaps(styles);
724      cleanFinish = true;
725    } finally {
726      currentLoadFileName = null;
727      status = loadStylesCompleted(cleanFinish);
728    }
729    return status;
730  }
731
732  private static void loadStylesFromMaps(Map<String, Map<String, String>> styles) {
733    for (Map.Entry<String, Map<String, String>> styleEntry : styles.entrySet()) {
734      String styleName = styleEntry.getKey();
735      Map<String, String> attrs = styleEntry.getValue();
736
737      // validate the new styleName, and register it
738      if (initialStyleNames.contains(styleName))
739        throw new TextStylesException("StyleName already exists");
740      newStyleNames.add(styleName); // happens before registry changed
741      // allocate an AttributeSet for the style and set its name
742      registry.computeIfAbsent(styleName, k -> {
743        SimpleAttributeSet attrSet = new SimpleAttributeSet();
744        attrSet.addAttribute(StyleConstants.NameAttribute, styleName);
745        return attrSet;
746      });
747
748      // for the styleName add each attribute to the AttributeSet
749      for (Map.Entry<String, String> attr : attrs.entrySet()) {
750        String propertyName = attr.getKey();
751        String value = attr.getValue();
752
753        if ("inherits".equalsIgnoreCase(propertyName)) {
754          inheritanceMap.put(styleName, value.trim());
755        } else {
756          SimpleAttributeSet attributeSet = registry.get(styleName);
757          mapPropertyToAttributeSet(attributeSet, propertyName, value);
758        }
759      }
760    }
761  }

763  // https://javadoc.io/doc/tools.jackson.core/jackson-core/3.2.1/index.html
764  // https://javadoc.io/doc/tools.jackson.dataformat/jackson-dataformat-properties/3.2.1/index.html
765  /**
766   * Input is parsed to a Map indexed by style name, and the value of each
767   * style name entry is a Map of attributes.
768   * For Jackson construct the
769   * {@code Map<String, Map<String, String>>} structural type dynamically.
770   */
771  private static JavaType stylesNestedMapType(ObjectMapper mapper) {
772    TypeFactory typeFactory = mapper.getTypeFactory();
773    JavaType mapType = typeFactory.constructMapType(
774        Map.class, typeFactory.constructType(String.class),
775        typeFactory.constructMapType(Map.class, String.class, String.class));
776    return mapType;
777  }

792   * made up to the exception are backed out.

803  /**
804   * <ul>
805   * <li> Detect duplicate keys instead of over-writing previous value.
806   * <li> Verify exactly one '.' in key.
807   * <li> No blank keys or values
808   * </ul>
809   *
810   * Tried using something like
811   *        static class DotSplitter extends JPropPathSplitter.CharPathOnlySplitter {}
812   * but no clean way to provide a splitter at this point.
813   */
814  @SuppressWarnings("serial")
815  private static class PrelimCheckProperties extends Properties {
816    @Override
817    public synchronized Object put(Object _key, Object _value) {
818      String key = (String) _key;
819      String value = (String) _value;
820      if(key.isBlank() || value.isBlank())
821        throw new TextStylesException(sf("blank key or value '%s':'%s'", key, value));
822      if (containsKey(key)) {
823        throw new TextStylesException(sf("Duplicate key found: %s=%s", key, value));
824      }
825      long count  = 0;
826      for (int i = 0; i < key.length(); i++) {
827        if (key.charAt(i) == '.')
828          count++;
829      }
830      if (count != 1) {
831        throw new TextStylesException(sf("Key must have exactly one '.' not %d: %s=%s",
832            count, key, value));
833      }
834      return super.put(key, value);
835    }
836  }
837
838  // Parse the properties into a map.
839  private static Map<String, Map<String, String>> parseProperties(Reader reader,
840                                                                  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
841                                                                      String fName)
842      throws IOException {
843    Properties props = new PrelimCheckProperties();
844    props.load(reader);
845    JavaPropsMapper mapper = JavaPropsMapper.builder().build();
846    JavaPropsSchema schemaWithDots = JavaPropsSchema.emptySchema();
847    Map<String, Map<String, String>> styles
848        = mapper.readPropertiesAs(props, schemaWithDots, stylesNestedMapType(mapper));
849    return styles;
850  }

883   * @param reader
884   * @param fName for messages, typically a file name
885   * @return
886   * @throws IOException
887   */

889      throws IOException {

893  private static Map<String, Map<String, String>> parseJson(Reader reader, String fName)
894      throws IOException {
895    ObjectMapper mapper = JsonMapper
896                              .builder()
897                              // .enable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_NULL_FOR_PRIMITIVES)
898                              .enable(StreamReadFeature.INCLUDE_SOURCE_IN_LOCATION)
899                              .enable(JsonReadFeature.ALLOW_YAML_COMMENTS)
900                              .enable(StreamReadFeature.STRICT_DUPLICATE_DETECTION)
901                              .enable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_READING_DUP_TREE_KEY)
902                              .build();
903
904    // Turn lines with comments into emtpy lines.
905    //      jsonInputString = jsonInputString.replaceAll("(?m)^\\s*#.*$", "");
906
907    try {
908      // Use TypeReference to cleanly parse directly into nested maps
909      Map<String, Map<String, String>> styles
910          = mapper.readValue(reader,
911                             //new TypeReference<Map<String, Map<String, String>>>() {}
912                             stylesNestedMapType(mapper));
913      return styles;
914    } catch (JacksonException ex) {
915      //System.err.println(ex.getMessage());
916      // TODO: parse exception
917      if (fName == null) {
918        logger.log(ERROR, ex.getMessage());
919        throw ex;
920      }
921      // Reproduce the error message,
922      // but put the filename in the loc, instead of something like "(StringReader)"
923      String loc = ex.getLocation().toString();
924      loc = loc.replace(ex.getLocation().sourceDescription(), fName);
925      String newMsg = sf("%s\nat %s (through reference chain: %s)", ex.getOriginalMessage(), loc,
926                         ex.getPathReference());
927      logger.log(ERROR, newMsg);
928      JacksonException je = new JacksonException(newMsg, ex) {
929        @Override
930        public String getMessage() {
931          return newMsg;
932        }
933      };
934      throw je;
935    }
936  }

964  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
965  private static LoadStatus loadStylesFromJsonRegEx(String _content) throws IOException {
966    boolean cleanFinish = false;
967    loadStylesStarting();
968    LoadStatus status;
969    try {
970      String content = _content.trim();
971      if (content.startsWith("{") && content.endsWith("}")) {
972        content = content.substring(1, content.length() - 1).trim();
973      }
974      Pattern blockPattern = Pattern.compile("\"([^\"]+)\"\\s*:\\s*\\{([^}]+)\\}");
975      Matcher blockMatcher = blockPattern.matcher(content);
976
977      while (blockMatcher.find()) {
978        String configName = blockMatcher.group(1);
979        String body = blockMatcher.group(2);
980        if (initialStyleNames.contains(configName))
981          throw new TextStylesException(sf("StyleName '%s' already exists", configName));
982        newStyleNames.add(configName); // happens before registry changed
983        if (registry.containsKey(configName))
984          throw new TextStylesException(
985              sf("StyleName '%s' already defined in this load", configName));
986
987        SimpleAttributeSet attributeSet = registry.computeIfAbsent(configName, k -> {
988          SimpleAttributeSet attrSet = new SimpleAttributeSet();
989          attrSet.addAttribute(StyleConstants.NameAttribute, configName);
990          return attrSet;
991        });
992        Pattern pairPattern = Pattern.compile("\"([^\"]+)\"\\s*:\\s*(?:\"([^\"]+)\"|([^,\\s]+))");
993        Matcher pairMatcher = pairPattern.matcher(body);
994
995        while (pairMatcher.find()) {
996          String propertyName = pairMatcher.group(1);
997          String value = pairMatcher.group(2) != null ? pairMatcher.group(2) : pairMatcher.group(3);
998          value = value.trim();
999
1000          if ("inherits".equalsIgnoreCase(propertyName)) {
1001            inheritanceMap.put(configName, value);
1002          } else {
1003            mapPropertyToAttributeSet(attributeSet, propertyName, value);
1004          }
1005        }
1006      }
1007      cleanFinish = true;
1008    } finally {
1009      status = loadStylesCompleted(cleanFinish);
1010    }
1011    return status;
1012  }
1013
1014  /** like Runnable, but IOException */
1015  public interface RunIO {
1016    /**
1017     * Run operation that might throw IOException.
1018     * @throws IOException
1019     */
1020    void run() throws IOException;
1021  }
1022
1023  /**
1024   * Convenience method; if this is called on the EDT, run the load on different thread.
1025   * Warning: if EDT, this will hang the EDT until load completes;
1026   * which is quickly unless blocked by a current load from a file.
1027   * @param load runnable that does the load
1028   * @throws java.io.IOException
1029   */
1030  // TODO: could add dialog with spinner
1031  public static void loadFromAnyThread(RunIO load) throws IOException {
1032    //System.err.printf("******* LOADING: %s\n", Instant.now());
1033    if (!EventQueue.isDispatchThread()) {
1034      load.run();
1035    } else {
1036      SwingWorker<Object, Object> sw = new SwingWorker<>() {
1037        @Override
1038        protected Object doInBackground() throws Exception {
1039          load.run();
1040          return null;
1041        }
1042      };
1043      sw.execute();
1044      Throwable ex = null;
1045      try {
1046        sw.get(); // Waits for completion.
1047      } catch (InterruptedException x) {
1048        ex = x;
1049      } catch (ExecutionException x) {
1050        ex = x.getCause();
1051      }
1052      if (ex != null) {
1053        if (ex instanceof IOException iox)
1054          throw iox;
1055        throw new IOException("Problem loading TextStyles", ex);
1056      }
1057    }
1058    //System.err.printf("******* LOADED: %s\n", Instant.now());
1059  }

1061  /** Convert, and return, style name to AttributeSet name */
1062  private static Object styleAttrName2AttrName(String key, String value) {
1063    Object attrName = switch (key) {
1064      case "alignment" -> StyleConstants.Alignment;
1065      case "foreground" -> StyleConstants.Foreground;
1066      case "background" -> StyleConstants.Background;
1067      case "opaque" -> STYLE_CONSTANT_OPAQUE;
1068      case "fontFamily" -> StyleConstants.FontFamily;
1069      case "fontSize" -> StyleConstants.FontSize;
1070      case "bold" -> StyleConstants.Bold;
1071      case "italic" -> StyleConstants.Italic;
1072      case "underline" -> StyleConstants.Underline;
1073      case "strikethrough" -> StyleConstants.StrikeThrough;
1074
1075      // JTextArea Only Layouts (Stored as custom attribute objects)
1076      case "linewrap" -> STYLE_CONSTANT_LINE_WRAP;
1077      case "wordwrap" -> STYLE_CONSTANT_WORD_WRAP;
1078      case "scrollbars" -> STYLE_CONSTANT_SCROLLBARS;
1079      case "autoscroll" -> STYLE_CONSTANT_AUTOSCROLL;
1080      default -> throw new TextStylesException(
1081          sf("Unhandled style attribute name '%s' at '%s: %s'", key, key, value));
1082    };
1083    return attrName;
1084  }
1085
1086  private static ValueDefault styleAttrName2Default(String key, AttributeSet attrSet) {
1087    Object dflt;
1088    Object attrName = switch (key) {
1089      case "foreground" -> {
1090        dflt = Color.BLACK;
1091        yield StyleConstants.Foreground;
1092      }
1093      case "background" -> {
1094        dflt = Color.WHITE;
1095        yield StyleConstants.Background;
1096      }
1097      case "opaque" -> {
1098        dflt = true;
1099        yield STYLE_CONSTANT_OPAQUE;
1100      }
1101      case "fontFamily" -> {
1102        dflt = "Monospaced";
1103        yield StyleConstants.FontFamily;
1104      }
1105      case "fontSize" -> {
1106        dflt = 12;
1107        yield StyleConstants.FontSize;
1108      }
1109      case "bold" -> {
1110        dflt = false;
1111        yield StyleConstants.Bold;
1112      }
1113      case "italic" -> {
1114        dflt = false;
1115        yield StyleConstants.Italic;
1116      }
1117      case "underline" -> {
1118        dflt = false;
1119        yield StyleConstants.Underline;
1120      }
1121      case "strikethrough" -> {
1122        dflt = false;
1123        yield StyleConstants.StrikeThrough;
1124      }
1125
1126        // JTextField only
1127      case "alignment" -> {
1128        dflt = StyleConstants.ALIGN_LEFT;
1129        yield StyleConstants.Alignment;
1130      }
1131
1132      // JTextArea Only Layouts (Stored as custom attribute objects)
1133      case "linewrap" -> {
1134        dflt = false;
1135        yield STYLE_CONSTANT_LINE_WRAP;
1136      }
1137      case "wordwrap" -> {
1138        dflt = false;
1139        yield STYLE_CONSTANT_WORD_WRAP;
1140      }
1141
1142      // JSCrollPane on JTextArea
1143      case "scrollbars" -> {
1144        dflt = "asneeded";
1145        yield STYLE_CONSTANT_SCROLLBARS;
1146      }
1147      case "autoscroll" -> {
1148        dflt = null;
1149        yield STYLE_CONSTANT_AUTOSCROLL;
1150      }
1151      default -> throw new TextStylesException(sf("Unhandled style attribute name '%s'", key));
1152    };
1153
1154    return new ValueDefault(attrSet.getAttribute(attrName), dflt);
1155  }
1156
1157  /**
1158   * keep: means do not modify existing value;<br>
1159   * useDflt: if value is null;<br>
1160   * dflt: null means special handling.
1161   */
1162  record ValueDefault(boolean keep, boolean useDflt, Object value, Object dflt) {
1163    ValueDefault(Object value, Object dflt) {
1164      this(value == null || ATTRIBUTE_KEEP.equals(value), ATTRIBUTE_DEFAULT.equals(value), value, dflt);
1165    }
1166  }
1167
1168  /**
1169   * Maps raw properties out of files to the SimpleAttributeSet.
1170   */
1171  private static void mapPropertyToAttributeSet(SimpleAttributeSet attrSet, String key,
1172                                                String value) {
1173    Object attrName = styleAttrName2AttrName(key, value);
1174    if (attrSet.isDefined(attrName)) {
1175      String msg = sf("AttrName '%s' already set in '%s'", key,
1176                      attrSet.getAttribute(StyleConstants.NameAttribute));
1177      logger.log(WARNING, msg);
1178      throw new TextStylesException(msg);
1179    }
1180    if (value.equals(ATTRIBUTE_KEEP)) {
1181      attrSet.addAttribute(attrName, ATTRIBUTE_KEEP);
1182      return;
1183    }
1184    if (value.equals(ATTRIBUTE_DEFAULT)) {
1185      attrSet.addAttribute(attrName, ATTRIBUTE_DEFAULT);
1186      return;
1187    }
1188
1189    switch (key) {
1190      // JTextField Only Layout
1191      case "alignment" -> {
1192        String cleanAlign = value.trim().toLowerCase();
1193        int alignValue = switch (cleanAlign) {
1194          case "center" -> StyleConstants.ALIGN_CENTER;
1195          case "right" -> StyleConstants.ALIGN_RIGHT;
1196          case "left" -> StyleConstants.ALIGN_LEFT;
1197          default -> {
1198            throw new TextStylesException(sf("'%s' not for '%s'", cleanAlign, key));
1199          }
1200        };
1201        StyleConstants.setAlignment(attrSet, alignValue);
1202      }
1203
1204      // Shared Core Attributes
1205      case "foreground" -> StyleConstants.setForeground(attrSet, parseColor(value));
1206      case "background" -> StyleConstants.setBackground(attrSet, parseColor(value));
1207      case "opaque" -> attrSet.addAttribute(STYLE_CONSTANT_OPAQUE, Boolean.valueOf(value));
1208      case "fontFamily" -> StyleConstants.setFontFamily(attrSet, value);
1209      case "fontSize" -> StyleConstants.setFontSize(attrSet, Integer.parseInt(value));
1210      case "bold" -> StyleConstants.setBold(attrSet, Boolean.parseBoolean(value));
1211      case "italic" -> StyleConstants.setItalic(attrSet, Boolean.parseBoolean(value));
1212      case "underline" -> StyleConstants.setUnderline(attrSet, Boolean.parseBoolean(value));
1213      case "strikethrough" -> StyleConstants.setStrikeThrough(attrSet, Boolean.parseBoolean(value));
1214
1215      // JTextArea Only Layouts (Stored as custom attribute objects)
1216      case "linewrap" -> attrSet.addAttribute(STYLE_CONSTANT_LINE_WRAP, Boolean.valueOf(value));
1217      case "wordwrap" -> attrSet.addAttribute(STYLE_CONSTANT_WORD_WRAP, Boolean.valueOf(value));
1218
1219      // Scroll Specific
1220      case "scrollbars" -> {
1221        String val = value.trim().toLowerCase();
1222        switch (val) {
1223          case "horizontal", "vertical", "both", "none", "asneeded" -> {
1224          }
1225          default -> {
1226            throw new TextStylesException(sf("'%s' not for '%s'", val, key));
1227          }
1228        }
1229        attrSet.addAttribute(STYLE_CONSTANT_SCROLLBARS, val);
1230      }
1231      case "autoscroll" -> attrSet.addAttribute(STYLE_CONSTANT_AUTOSCROLL, Boolean.valueOf(value));
1232    }
1233    // Something should always gets set.
1234    if (!attrSet.isDefined(attrName))
1235      throw new TextStylesException(sf("Nothing was set for %s", attrName));
1236  }
1237
1238  /**
1239   * Tries parsing a color string as a standard hex literal first (e.g., "#FF0000").
1240   * If that fails, uses reflection to look up case-insensitive color names in java.awt.Color,
1241   * ignoring any underscores (e.g., "dark_GRAY", "darkGray", "black").
1242   */
1243  private static Color parseColor(String value) {
1244    if (value == null) {
1245      // Think this is impossible
1246      logger.log(ERROR, () -> sf("NULL colore"));
1247      throw new TextStylesException(sf("NULL color"));
1248    }
1249
1250    String val = value.trim();
1251
1252    // 1. Try resolving standard Web/Hex constants
1253    if (val.startsWith("#")) {
1254      try {
1255        return Color.decode(val);
1256      } catch (NumberFormatException _) {
1257        logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("Invalid hex format: %s. Attempting string lookup.", val));
1258      }
1259    }
1260
1261    // 2. Fall back to case-insensitive, symbol-agnostic reflection lookup
1262    String cleanValue = val.replace("_", "").toLowerCase();
1263
1264    // Quick custom map for standard colors to speed up runtime lookup
1265    Color color = switch (cleanValue) {
1266      case "black" -> Color.BLACK;
1267      case "blue" -> Color.BLUE;
1268      case "cyan" -> Color.CYAN;
1269      case "darkgray" -> Color.DARK_GRAY;
1270      case "gray" -> Color.GRAY;
1271      case "green" -> Color.GREEN;
1272      case "lightgray" -> Color.LIGHT_GRAY;
1273      case "magenta" -> Color.MAGENTA;
1274      case "orange" -> Color.ORANGE;
1275      case "pink" -> Color.PINK;
1276      case "red" -> Color.RED;
1277      case "white" -> Color.WHITE;
1278      case "yellow" -> Color.YELLOW;
1279      default -> null;
1280    };
1281    if (color != null)
1282      return color;
1283
1284    // Deep reflection fallback for environment-specific or extended Look-And-Feel colors
1285    try {
1286      for (java.lang.reflect.Field field : Color.class.getFields()) {
1287        if (java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(field.getModifiers())
1288            && field.getType() == Color.class) {
1289          String fieldName = field.getName().replace("_", "").toLowerCase();
1290          if (fieldName.equals(cleanValue)) {
1291            return (Color) field.get(null);
1292          }
1293        }
1294      }
1295    } catch (IllegalAccessException | IllegalArgumentException e) {
1296      String msg = sf("Reflection failed for color property: %s", val);
1297      logger.log(ERROR, msg, e);
1298      throw new TextStylesException(msg, e);
1299    }
1300
1301    logger.log(ERROR, () -> sf("Color '%s' unrecognized.", val));
1302    throw new TextStylesException(sf("Unrecognized color: '%s'", val));
1303    // logger.log(WARNING, () -> sf("Color '%s' unrecognized. Defaulting to BLACK.", val));
1304    // return Color.BLACK;
1305  }

1307  // This is probably good enough...
1308  private static JScrollPane findScrollPane(JTextArea c) {
1309    return (JScrollPane) SwingUtilities.getAncestorOfClass(JScrollPane.class, c);
1310  }

1312  /**
1313   * Styling engine for: JComponent.
1314   * The style's name is saved as the JCompoent's
1315   * {@link #STYLE_NAME} ClientProperty.
1316   *
1317   * @param jComponent
1318   * @param style
1319   */
1320  public static void applyStyle(JComponent jComponent, AttributeSet style) {
1321    verifyEDT();
1322    ComponentMemento resetMemento = resetMementos.get(jComponent);
1323    if (style == RESET) {
1324      // Could remove the resetMemento map entry, but performance waste
1325      // since RESET is common; instead could have "forgetResetMemento" method
1326      if (resetMemento != null) {
1327        resetMemento.restoreTo(jComponent);
1328      }
1329      jComponent.putClientProperty(STYLE_NAME, null);
1330      return;
1331    }
1332
1333    // There are no exceptions thrown during applyStyle, so just do it now.
1334    // If there is a problem, this could be a bread crumb.
1335    jComponent.putClientProperty(STYLE_NAME, style.getAttribute(StyleConstants.NameAttribute));
1336
1337    if (resetMemento == null)
1338      resetMementos.put(jComponent, getMemento(jComponent));
1339
1340    if (jComponent instanceof JTextArea textArea) {
1341      applyStyle(textArea, style);
1342      return;
1343    }
1344
1345    // [JTextField Only Attribute]: Horizontal Component Position Alignment
1346    if (jComponent instanceof JTextField textField) {
1347      ValueDefault vd = styleAttrName2Default("alignment", style);
1348      if (!vd.keep) {
1349        int alignment = (int) (vd.useDflt() ? vd.dflt() : vd.value());
1350        switch (alignment) {
1351          case StyleConstants.ALIGN_CENTER:
1352            textField.setHorizontalAlignment(JTextField.CENTER);
1353            break;
1354          case StyleConstants.ALIGN_RIGHT:
1355            textField.setHorizontalAlignment(JTextField.RIGHT);
1356            break;
1357          case StyleConstants.ALIGN_LEFT:
1358          case StyleConstants
1359              .ALIGN_JUSTIFIED: // JTextField does not support true body justification, fall back to left
1360          default: textField.setHorizontalAlignment(JTextField.LEFT); break;
1361        }
1362      }
1363    }
1364
1365    // Apply shared core layout decorations (Colors & Fonts)
1366    applyCoreStyle(jComponent, style);
1367  }
1368
1369  /**
1370   * Styling engine for: JTextArea
1371   *
1372   * @param textArea
1373   * @param style
1374   */
1375  private static void applyStyle(JTextArea textArea, AttributeSet style) {
1376    verifyEDT();
1377    // [JTextArea Only Attribute]: Multi-line Line wrapping configuration
1378    boolean isOn;
1379    ValueDefault vd = styleAttrName2Default("linewrap", style);
1380    if (!vd.keep()) {
1381      isOn = (boolean) (vd.useDflt ? vd.dflt() : vd.value());
1382      textArea.setLineWrap(isOn);
1383    }
1384
1385    // [JTextArea Only Attribute]: Word boundary wrap breaking configuration
1386    vd = styleAttrName2Default("wordwrap", style);
1387    if (!vd.keep()) {
1388      isOn = (boolean) (vd.useDflt ? vd.dflt() : vd.value());
1389      textArea.setWrapStyleWord(isOn);
1390    }
1391
1392    // Apply shared core layout decorations (Colors & Fonts)
1393    applyCoreStyle(textArea, style);
1394
1395    JScrollPane jsp = findScrollPane(textArea);
1396    if (jsp == null)
1397      return;
1398
1399    vd = styleAttrName2Default("scrollbars", style);
1400    if (!vd.keep()) {
1401      String policy = (String) (vd.useDflt ? vd.dflt() : vd.value());
1402      int vsb = JScrollPane.VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_AS_NEEDED;
1403      int hsb = JScrollPane.HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_AS_NEEDED;
1404      switch (policy) {
1405        case "asneeded" -> {
1406          vsb = JScrollPane.VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_AS_NEEDED;
1407          hsb = JScrollPane.HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_AS_NEEDED;
1408        }
1409        case "vertical" -> {
1410          vsb = JScrollPane.VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_ALWAYS;
1411          hsb = JScrollPane.HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_NEVER;
1412        }
1413        case "horizontal" -> {
1414          vsb = JScrollPane.VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_NEVER;
1415          hsb = JScrollPane.HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_ALWAYS;
1416        }
1417        case "both" -> {
1418          vsb = JScrollPane.VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_ALWAYS;
1419          hsb = JScrollPane.HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_ALWAYS;
1420        }
1421        case "none" -> {
1422          vsb = JScrollPane.VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_NEVER;
1423          hsb = JScrollPane.HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_NEVER;
1424        }
1425      }
1426      jsp.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(vsb);
1427      jsp.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(hsb);
1428    }
1429
1430    vd = styleAttrName2Default("autoscroll", style);
1431    // NOTE: for autoscroll, the default is to do nothing
1432    if (!vd.useDflt()) {
1433      DefaultCaret caret = (DefaultCaret) textArea.getCaret();
1434      if (!vd.keep())
1435        caret.setUpdatePolicy((boolean) vd.value() ? DefaultCaret.ALWAYS_UPDATE
1436                                                   : DefaultCaret.NEVER_UPDATE);
1437    }
1438  }
1439
1440  /**
1441   * Extracts and applies properties common to all JTextComponent fields.
1442   * @param component
1443   * @param style
1444   */
1445  private static void applyCoreStyle(JComponent component, AttributeSet style) {
1446    // 1. Process Core Component Foreground/Background Colors
1447
1448    ValueDefault vd = styleAttrName2Default("foreground", style);
1449    if (!vd.keep()) {
1450      component.setForeground((Color) (vd.useDflt ? vd.dflt() : vd.value()));
1451    }
1452
1453    vd = styleAttrName2Default("background", style);
1454    if (!vd.keep()) {
1455      component.setBackground((Color) (vd.useDflt ? vd.dflt() : vd.value()));
1456    }
1457
1458    vd = styleAttrName2Default("opaque", style);
1459    if (!vd.keep()) {
1460      component.setOpaque((boolean) (vd.useDflt() ? vd.dflt() : vd.value()));
1461    }
1462
1463    // 2. Process Core Font Typography configurations
1464
1465    Map<TextAttribute, Object> fontAttributes = new HashMap<>();
1466    Font currentFont = component.getFont();
1467
1468    vd = styleAttrName2Default("fontFamily", style);
1469    String family
1470        = vd.keep() ? currentFont.getFamily() : (String) (vd.useDflt() ? vd.dflt() : vd.value());
1471
1472    vd = styleAttrName2Default("fontSize", style);
1473    int size = vd.keep ? currentFont.getSize() : (int) (vd.useDflt() ? vd.dflt() : vd.value());
1474
1475    fontAttributes.put(TextAttribute.FAMILY, family);
1476    fontAttributes.put(TextAttribute.SIZE, (float) size);
1477
1478    Map<TextAttribute, ?> currentFontAttributes = currentFont.getAttributes();
1479
1480    vd = styleAttrName2Default("underline", style);
1481    boolean isOn = vd.keep()      ? TextAttribute.UNDERLINE_ON.equals(
1482                                        currentFontAttributes.get(TextAttribute.UNDERLINE))
1483                   : vd.useDflt() ? false
1484                                  : (boolean) vd.value();
1485    if (isOn)
1486      fontAttributes.put(TextAttribute.UNDERLINE, TextAttribute.UNDERLINE_ON);
1487
1488    vd = styleAttrName2Default("strikethrough", style);
1489    isOn = vd.keep()      ? TextAttribute.STRIKETHROUGH_ON.equals(
1490                                currentFontAttributes.get(TextAttribute.STRIKETHROUGH))
1491           : vd.useDflt() ? false
1492                          : (boolean) vd.value();
1493    if (isOn)
1494      fontAttributes.put(TextAttribute.STRIKETHROUGH, TextAttribute.STRIKETHROUGH_ON);
1495
1496    int currentFontStyle = currentFont.getStyle();
1497    int fontStyle = Font.PLAIN;
1498    vd = styleAttrName2Default("bold", style);
1499    isOn = vd.keep() ? (currentFontStyle & Font.BOLD) != 0
1500                     : (boolean) (vd.useDflt() ? vd.dflt() : vd.value());
1501    fontStyle |= isOn ? Font.BOLD : 0;
1502
1503    vd = styleAttrName2Default("italic", style);
1504    isOn = vd.keep() ? (currentFontStyle & Font.ITALIC) != 0
1505                     : (boolean) (vd.useDflt() ? vd.dflt() : vd.value());
1506    fontStyle |= isOn ? Font.ITALIC : 0;
1507
1508    Font baseFont = new Font(family, fontStyle, size);
1509    component.setFont(baseFont.deriveFont(fontAttributes));
1510    component.repaint();
1511  }
1512
1513  static ComponentMemento getMemento(JComponent c) {
1514    return new ComponentMemento(c);
1515  }

1517  /**
1518   * For saving and restoring component state changed by styles.
1519   */
1520  public static class ComponentMemento {
1521    // Shared Core Core Properties
1522    private final Color foreground;
1523    private final Color background;
1524    private final Font font;
1525    private final boolean opaque;
1526
1527    // JTextField Specific Properties
1528    private final boolean isTextField;
1529    private final int alignment;
1530
1531    // JTextArea Specific Properties
1532    private final boolean isTextArea;
1533    private final boolean lineWrap;
1534    private final boolean wordWrap;
1535    private final boolean hasScrollPane;
1536    private final int vsb;
1537    private final int hsb;
1538
1539    /**
1540     * Capture state snapshot;
1541     * Accepts any standard JTextComponent (JTextField, JTextArea, JPasswordField, etc.)
1542     * @param jComponent
1543     */
1544    public ComponentMemento(JComponent jComponent) {
1545      Objects.requireNonNull(jComponent);
1546      verifyEDT();
1547      // Capture Shared Core Layout Parameters
1548      foreground = jComponent.getForeground();
1549      background = jComponent.getBackground();
1550      opaque = jComponent.isOpaque();
1551      font = jComponent.getFont();
1552
1553      // JTextField parameters
1554      isTextField = jComponent instanceof JTextField;
1555      alignment = isTextField ? ((JTextField)jComponent).getHorizontalAlignment() : 0;
1556
1557      // Identify type and pull multi-line parameters if it's a JTextArea
1558      if (jComponent instanceof JTextArea textArea) {
1559        isTextArea = true;
1560        lineWrap = textArea.getLineWrap();
1561        wordWrap = textArea.getWrapStyleWord();
1562      } else {
1563        isTextArea = false;
1564        lineWrap = false;
1565        wordWrap = false;
1566      }
1567
1568      JScrollPane jsp = isTextArea ? findScrollPane((JTextArea) jComponent) : null;
1569      if (jsp != null) {
1570        hasScrollPane = true;
1571        vsb = jsp.getVerticalScrollBarPolicy();
1572        hsb = jsp.getHorizontalScrollBarPolicy();
1573      } else {
1574        hasScrollPane = false;
1575        vsb = 0;
1576        hsb = 0;
1577      }
1578    }
1579
1580    /**
1581     * Restore state snapshot;
1582     * Restores all core attributes and conditionally re-applies multi-line rules.
1583     * @param jComponent
1584     */
1585    public void restoreTo(JComponent jComponent) {
1586      Objects.requireNonNull(jComponent);
1587      verifyEDT();
1588      // Restore Shared Layout States
1589      jComponent.setForeground(foreground);
1590      jComponent.setBackground(background);
1591      jComponent.setOpaque(opaque);
1592      jComponent.setFont(font);
1593
1594      // Safely re-apply specific wrap layers only if targets match up
1595
1596      if (isTextField && jComponent instanceof JTextField textField) {
1597        textField.setHorizontalAlignment(alignment);
1598      }
1599
1600      if (isTextArea && jComponent instanceof JTextArea textArea) {
1601        //JTextArea textArea = (JTextArea) jComponent;
1602        textArea.setLineWrap(lineWrap);
1603        textArea.setWrapStyleWord(wordWrap);
1604        JScrollPane jsp = findScrollPane(textArea);
1605        if (hasScrollPane && jsp != null) {
1606          jsp.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(vsb);
1607          jsp.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(hsb);
1608        }
1609      }
1610
1611      jComponent.repaint();
1612    }
1613
1614    /** original foreground of JComponent.
1615     * @return  */
1616    public Color getForeground() {
1617      return foreground;
1618    }
1619
1620    /** original background of JComponent.
1621     * @return  */
1622    public Color getBackground() {
1623      return background;
1624    }
1625
1626    /** original opaque of JComponent.
1627     * @return  */
1628    public boolean isOpaque() {
1629      return opaque;
1630    }
1631
1632    /** original font of JComponent.
1633     * @return  */
1634    public Font getFont() {
1635      return font;
1636    }
1637
1638    /** False when values collected from component that was not a TextFeild.
1639     * @return  true if values collected from TextArea */
1640    public boolean isTextField() {
1641      return isTextField;
1642    }
1643
1644    /** original alignment of JTextField.
1645     * @return  */
1646    public int getAlignment() {
1647      return alignment;
1648    }
1649
1650    /** False when values collected from component that was not a TextArea.
1651     * @return  true if values collected from TextArea */
1652    public boolean isTextArea() {
1653      return isTextArea;
1654    }
1655
1656    /** original LineWrap of TextArea.
1657     * @return  */
1658    public boolean isLineWrap() {
1659      return lineWrap;
1660    }
1661
1662    /** original WordWrap of TextArea.
1663     * @return  */
1664    public boolean isWordWrap() {
1665      return wordWrap;
1666    }
1667
1668    /** original TextArea has a ScrollPane.
1669     * @return  */
1670    public boolean hasScrollPane() {
1671      return hasScrollPane;
1672    }
1673
1674    /** original VerticalScrollBar policy of TextArea's ScrollPane.
1675     * @return  */
1676    public int getVsb() {
1677      return vsb;
1678    }
1679
1680    /** original HorizontalScrollBar policy of TextArea's ScrollPane.
1681     * @return  */
1682    public int getHsb() {
1683      return hsb;
1684    }
1685
1686    /** {@inheritDoc} */
1687    @Override
1688    public String toString() {
1689      String hexFore = sf("#%06x", (0xFFFFFF & foreground.getRGB()));
1690      String hexBack = sf("#%06x", (0xFFFFFF & background.getRGB()));
1691      Map<TextAttribute, ?> currentFontAttributes = font.getAttributes();
1692      boolean underline
1693          = TextAttribute.UNDERLINE_ON.equals(currentFontAttributes.get(TextAttribute.UNDERLINE));
1694      boolean strikethrough = TextAttribute.STRIKETHROUGH_ON.equals(
1695          currentFontAttributes.get(TextAttribute.STRIKETHROUGH));
1696      String stringAlignment = switch (alignment) {
1697        case JTextField.LEFT -> "left";
1698        case JTextField.CENTER -> "center";
1699        case JTextField.RIGHT -> "right";
1700        case JTextField.LEADING -> "leading";
1701        case JTextField.TRAILING -> "trailing";
1702        default -> "" + alignment;
1703      };
1704
1705      return "ComponentMemento{"
1706          + "foreground=" + hexFore + ", background=" + hexBack + ", opaque=" + opaque
1707          + ", font=" + font + ", underline=" + underline + ", strikethrough=" + strikethrough
1708          + ", isTextField=" + isTextField + ", alignment=" + stringAlignment
1709          + ", isTextArea=" + isTextArea + ", lineWrap=" + lineWrap + ", wordWrap=" + wordWrap +
1710          ", hasScrollPane=" + hasScrollPane + ", vsb=" + vsb + ", hsb=" + hsb + '}';
1711    }
1712
1713    /** {@inheritDoc} */
1714    @Override
1715    public int hashCode() {
1716      int hash = 5;
1717      hash = 29 * hash + Objects.hashCode(this.foreground);
1718      hash = 29 * hash + Objects.hashCode(this.background);
1719      hash = 29 * hash + Objects.hashCode(this.font);
1720      hash = 29 * hash + (this.opaque ? 1 : 0);
1721      hash = 29 * hash + (this.isTextField ? 1 : 0);
1722      hash = 29 * hash + this.alignment;
1723      hash = 29 * hash + (this.isTextArea ? 1 : 0);
1724      hash = 29 * hash + (this.lineWrap ? 1 : 0);
1725      hash = 29 * hash + (this.wordWrap ? 1 : 0);
1726      hash = 29 * hash + (this.hasScrollPane ? 1 : 0);
1727      hash = 29 * hash + this.vsb;
1728      hash = 29 * hash + this.hsb;
1729      return hash;
1730    }
1731
1732    /** {@inheritDoc} */
1733    @Override
1734    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
1735      if (this == obj)
1736        return true;
1737      if (obj == null)
1738        return false;
1739      if (getClass() != obj.getClass())
1740        return false;
1741      final ComponentMemento other = (ComponentMemento) obj;
1742      if (this.opaque != other.opaque)
1743        return false;
1744      if (this.isTextField != other.isTextField)
1745        return false;
1746      if (this.alignment != other.alignment)
1747        return false;
1748      if (this.isTextArea != other.isTextArea)
1749        return false;
1750      if (this.lineWrap != other.lineWrap)
1751        return false;
1752      if (this.wordWrap != other.wordWrap)
1753        return false;
1754      if (this.hasScrollPane != other.hasScrollPane)
1755        return false;
1756      if (this.vsb != other.vsb)
1757        return false;
1758      if (this.hsb != other.hsb)
1759        return false;
1760      if (!Objects.equals(this.foreground, other.foreground))
1761        return false;
1762      if (!Objects.equals(this.background, other.background))
1763        return false;
1764      return Objects.equals(this.font, other.font);
1765    }
1766  }
